requestedIntent: Keep focused RED valuable without paying for repeated Test Author context in bounded work, and prevent linked-worktree test infrastructure from creating false product evidence.
limitations: The integrated RED default is supported by the preregistered ATDD-MIN-1 calibration; it remains enforced rather than proven until live product canaries reproduce the speed result without a quality regression.
The worktree runner isolates names and detects external Composer/vendor resolution. Target-specific services must still honor the emitted DB/cache/queue/port environment values.
Infrastructure retry is mechanically trusted only for the installed worktree runner's exit 75 marker and is capped at two attempts; ordinary failing tests remain immutable product evidence.
Existing in-flight runs without redOwnershipContract retain their original contract and are not reinterpreted after installation.
